brent.availability: the assessment for date d is taken as available at 17:00 New York on the NEXT calendar day (one full day of lag: the spot assessment is published after the London close)
brent.licence: U.S. government work (public domain), via datahub.io
brent.publisher: U.S. EIA, Europe Brent Spot Price FOB (RBRTE), daily
brent.revised: EIA spot assessments are not revised in practice

cpi_us.availability: BLS releases month m around the 10th-17th of m+1 (the 2013 shutdown delayed one to the 30th); taken as available at 17:00 New York on the LAST day of m+1
cpi_us.publisher: U.S. BLS, CPI-U all items, not seasonally adjusted (1982-84=100)
cpi_us.revised: the NSA index is never revised (only seasonal factors are, and they are not used)

sp500.availability: the average for month m is known once m ends; available at 17:00 New York on the 2nd calendar day of m+1
sp500.publisher: S&P 500 monthly average level (R. Shiller's dataset)
sp500.revised: a published index level; not revised

us10y.availability: the average for month m is known once m ends; taken as available at 17:00 New York on the 2nd calendar day of month m+1
us10y.publisher: Federal Reserve H.15, 10-year Treasury constant maturity, monthly average
us10y.revised: H.15 market yields are not revised

vix.availability: the close of date d is public at 16:15 New York; taken as available at 16:45 New York on d (before the 17:00 New York close that ends our D1 bar)
vix.licence: Cboe public historical data, mirrored by datahub.io core (PDDL)
vix.publisher: Cboe Global Markets (VIX index, daily close)
